module.title: General-relativistic hydrodynamics and MHD on fixed metrics
module.expensive_path: Metric-aware flux evaluation: frame transformation of primitives to a local orthonormal frame, GR Riemann solve, transformation back, plus metric-dependent source terms and the GR conserved-to-primitive inversion.
module.rationale: GR adds the coordinate/metric layer (16k lines of coordinates/) and the frame-transform option (-t) on top of SR; eight runtime tests cover the shock tubes with and without transform, three more only check that curved-metric coordinates compile.
excluded: The three compile-only tests are build checks, not fidelity checks; survey will mark them unsuitable
hazards: Runtime tests all use Minkowski coordinates; curved-metric physics is only compile-covered upstream
